recipe: Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on one RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: 262,144 context, native vision, MTP-2 + fp8 KV, 1,024-token prefill batches, thermal scheduler (v2, promoted)
note: Every entry is a transcription made by the studio. The basis field is the studio's original wording; read it with the label in the recipe: an entry without a published raw file is REPORTED, whatever its basis says.

receipts.claim: KV cache pool, staged profile (MTP-2 + fp8 KV, 51% memory fraction, scheduler on) [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.caveat: Warm compile cache. The same flags measured 469,178 tokens with a cold compile cache (Q-02). Single boot each; the pool after a production restart is not yet read.

receipts.claim: KV cache pool, same flags, cold compile cache [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.value: 469,178 tokens
receipts.caveat: Peak activation during profiling was 3.75 GiB cold against 1.36-1.40 GiB warm; the pool size depends on which one the engine sees.

receipts.claim: KV cache pool of the current serving profile (51%, default KV dtype, no MTP)
receipts.caveat: Value carried by the staging harness as the reference for the serving profile; not re-measured in this run.

receipts.claim: Decode throughput of the staged profile at 1 / 4 / 16 concurrent streams [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.value: 88.5 / 312.1 / 911.0 tokens/s aggregate (89.0 / 78.8 / 61.1 per stream median)
receipts.caveat: Method: 256 output tokens per request, temperature 0, short prompts, 2 / 8 / 16 requests, loopback client, one run. The 16-stream sample lasted 4.5 s. A sample, not a load test. 0 errors.

receipts.claim: Decode throughput of the same model with no MTP and default KV dtype (reference, two boots)
receipts.caveat: Same method as Q-04, but 70% memory fraction and no in-engine scheduler (an external script paced the card). The spread at 16 streams (453 to 608 between two boots) is the noise to keep in mind for every 16-stream figure here.

receipts.claim: Decode speed-up of the staged profile against the reference
receipts.value: about 2.0x at 1 stream, about 2.6x at 4, 1.5x to 2.0x at 16
receipts.caveat: Ratio of Q-04 to Q-05 (mean of the two boots at 1 and 4 streams). The two runs differ in memory fraction and scheduler, so read it as an order of magnitude, not a controlled A/B.

receipts.claim: MTP draft acceptance (2 draft tokens) [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.value: 0.800 over the whole staging run (6,002 drafted, 4,803 accepted); 0.760 over a 6-minute 16-stream load; 0.917 on a block of short answers
receipts.caveat: Acceptance depends on the text being generated; short, predictable answers accept more.

receipts.claim: Speculative depth: 1 draft token versus 2 (MTP alone, no fp8 KV)
receipts.caveat: One run each at 70% memory fraction; 16-stream numbers differ by less than the boot-to-boot spread in Q-05.

receipts.claim: fp8 KV cache alone (no MTP)
receipts.value: KV pool 1,120,891 vs 571,950 tokens at the same 70% fraction (1.96x); decode 43.4 / 138.9 / 371.3 tokens/s
receipts.caveat: The decode rate does not improve; the gain is memory. The checkpoint ships no KV scales, so fp8 attention runs with scale 1.0 (Q-19).

receipts.claim: 258,886-token three-position retrieval, staged profile, cold [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.value: passed (3 of 3 phrases), 346.75 s, 66 output tokens
receipts.caveat: Includes 87 external pauses of 1 to 2 s each (the test harness stops the engine at 88 C and resumes at 84 C); pause time inside this probe was not separated (the whole run had 111 pauses, 136.6 s). A prompt with the same builder and phrases as the serving-profile probe in Q-12. GPU peak 88 C.

receipts.claim: Same probe, scheduler class removed, otherwise the same flags
receipts.value: passed, 305.74 s
receipts.caveat: 35 external pauses. The difference to Q-10 is the number of pauses, not the scheduler (which held 0 times).

receipts.claim: Same probe on the serving profile (no MTP, default KV dtype), through the LAN API
receipts.value: passed, 468.94 s, peak 86 C
receipts.caveat: One run. The card was shared with three other resident models and a LAN consumer, and the software pacing lines then in force were lower than today. Not a like-for-like comparison with Q-10.

receipts.claim: About 200,000-token cold probe, staged profile [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.value: passed, 191.79 s (24 pauses) and 168.44 s (6 pauses) in two runs; 199,888 prompt tokens
receipts.caveat: Distinct header and phrases so no prefix-cache hit. Pause counts differ between the runs.

receipts.claim: Cold prefill with fp8 KV against default KV at 160,045 prompt tokens
receipts.value: cold 125.88 s (fp8 KV) vs 169.59 s (default); identical-prompt repeat 0.55 s vs 0.63 s
receipts.caveat: One run each, 80% memory fraction, no scheduler class, no MTP. The builder aimed at about 110,000 tokens; the server-reported prompt_tokens (160,045) is what is quoted. A prefix-caching flag changed nothing (it is already on). Two distinct concurrent prompts: 196.56 s vs 234.94 s wall.

receipts.claim: Average prompt-processing rate on cold long prompts
receipts.caveat: Prompt tokens divided by total wall time of one request, including 66 output tokens and any external pauses. It is a wall-clock average, not an isolated prefill kernel rate, and it falls with prompt length.

receipts.claim: Twelve-case regression fixture (format, arithmetic, tool call, long-context needle, limits) [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.value: 11 of 12 pass at 3 samples; the miss is one arithmetic case that the serving profile fails the same way
receipts.caveat: A basic fixture, not a quality evaluation. Direct probes on the six arithmetic prompts gave identical answers on the serving profile and the staged profile, so the miss belongs to the checkpoint. Tool-call fixture 3 of 3.

receipts.claim: Six-minute sustained 16-stream decode at the 300 W power limit [STAGING, language-model-only]
receipts.value: 1,373 requests, 350,436 output tokens, 0 errors; 810 to 1,100 tokens/s per 10-second bucket; mean about 973 tokens/s
receipts.caveat: Mean is derived (350,436 tokens / 360 s). GPU temperature rose from 73 C to 86 C within the opening minute, then sat at 87 to 88 C (monitor peak 89 C). The 90 C pause line was never reached, so the in-engine scheduler never held.

receipts.claim: Scheduler hold with MTP drafts in flight, live
receipts.value: not observed
receipts.caveat: Covered by a CPU unit test (zero-budget hold keeps two drafts and resumes with exactly 1 + 2 tokens) and by reading the vLLM 0.32.0 scheduler code; the live case is unknown because the card did not reach the pause line.

receipts.claim: Engine log warning about fp8 attention scales
receipts.value: KV scale 1.0, uncalibrated q_scale and prob_scale
receipts.caveat: The checkpoint ships no k/v scales. The fixtures pass, but they do not evaluate fp8 attention quality; no perplexity or long-context quality comparison was run.

receipts.claim: Weights and engine memory
receipts.value: model 27.99 GiB with the MTP head (27.55 GiB without); ready in 42 s with a warm compile cache; 132 s on a cold start
receipts.caveat: Boot times are from the engine log; cold start includes kernel compilation.

receipts.claim: Linear backend switch for the fp8 weights (b12x kernel)
receipts.value: no gain: 44.1 / 119.4 / 515.9 tokens/s, 126 s start-up, pool 572,719 tokens
receipts.caveat: Inside the boot-to-boot noise of Q-05.

receipts.claim: Status of the profile when v1 was written (superseded by Q-24)
receipts.value: v1 of this recipe: verdict recorded as go; not yet applied to the serving card
receipts.caveat: Historical. The profile was promoted on 2026-11-05 at 21:12Z; see Q-24.

receipts.claim: GPU temperatures reached while staging
receipts.value: staging card peak 88 C during probes, 86 C during regression and decode; the other card peaked 89 C under another job
receipts.caveat: Harness pauses at 88 C / resume 84 C (external); the initial staging run was cut at 85 s because the other card reached 90 C, which the older harness treated as a stop (T-08).

receipts.claim: Production promotion of native vision + MTP-2 + fp8 KV in one restart
receipts.value: PASS: one maintenance-wrapped restart of the serving unit, finished 2026-11-05 21:12:56Z; readiness wait 171.2 s; the receipt records 1 request undrained when the drain window closed; the profile's post-checks all passed and no rollback ran
receipts.caveat: One promotion, one restart. The drain was bounded at 120 s and did not complete: one in-flight request was undrained. Downtime seen by clients was not measured separately.

receipts.claim: KV cache pool after the production restart
receipts.value: 464,709 tokens (1.77x of 262,144), up from 319,800 on the previous serving profile (+45%)
receipts.caveat: Printed by the promotion script after the restart. It matches the staged number (464,709). The earlier staged MTP-only figure of 536,203 (Q-01) is higher because the vision encoder's profiling takes memory.

receipts.claim: Post-restart checks through the LAN API
receipts.value: 1-token request: HTTP 200 in 0.65 s (17 prompt tokens); red and blue solid-colour image request through the production endpoint: both answered correctly; speculative-decoding counters after the checks: 4 draft tokens proposed and 4 accepted
receipts.caveat: Three tiny requests. They show vision and MTP are live; they are not a speed or accuracy measurement.

receipts.claim: Post-restart check suite of the lab's health tooling
receipts.value: 31 of 31 checks passed
receipts.caveat: Taken from the lab's record for the promotion. The raw output of that run was not found, so this is reported, not re-read. The suite checks service health, protocols and the gateway; it is not a quality evaluation.

receipts.claim: Vision fixture on the promoted production profile
receipts.value: an error-screenshot fixture: HTTP 200 in 6.08 s; the error code, host name and port were transcribed correctly. A 1x1-pixel blue control image was answered with the word 'I', which is not a pass
receipts.caveat: Loopback, one fixture, one run, other traffic present. A fixture-level PASS, not a vision quality evaluation. The formal 12-case regression over the production endpoint did not run: it refused because another consumer was connected (HOLD).

receipts.claim: Decode speed on the promoted production profile
receipts.value: UNKNOWN. The one production reading: one short request, inter-token latency p50 37.4 ms (about 26.7 tokens/s single stream) while another consumer shared the engine; the previous profile's regression chat throughput was 46.4 tokens/s
receipts.caveat: INCONCLUSIVE, not a verdict. Confounds: shared engine, just 5 tokens generated, speculative-decoding cost. It is listed so that nobody quotes the staged 88-93 tokens/s as a production number. A clean-window re-baseline is open.

receipts.claim: Staged combined profile (vision + MTP-2 + fp8 KV, scheduler on) on the second card, before promotion
receipts.value: boot 90 s; decode 92.5 / 329.9 / 930.9 tokens/s aggregate at 1 / 4 / 16 streams; MTP acceptance 0.792; 258,886-token retrieval PASS in 324.8 s; image fixtures 6/6 and concurrency 4 and 16 with drafts 12/12 and 32/32 correct; 12-case fixture 11 of 12; peak 88 C
receipts.caveat: Staging card, harness pauses at 88 C (63 in the long probe), short samples, one run. These are the closest available numbers for the promoted flags, and they are staging numbers, not production numbers.

receipts.claim: 258,886-token retrieval on the promoted production profile
receipts.value: not run
receipts.caveat: The follow-up probe through the production endpoint had not been run when this was written. The last production figure is the old profile's 468.94 s (Q-12).

receipts.claim: Image input at the gateway
receipts.value: inline data:image URIs accepted for this model; remote image URLs refused; images above 4096 px per side or 8,847,360 pixels rejected with HTTP 400; at most 16 images and 2 videos per prompt
receipts.caveat: Read from commits and launch flags. The size cap was added after a red-team finding (see the image-size-cap note (withdrawn for now)) and its rejection was not retested.

receipts.claim: Vision variants staged before the combined profile
receipts.value: vision alone (no MTP, default KV): KV pool 279,056 tokens, 8.1% under the serving floor of 303,810 (12.7% under the earlier 319,800 pool), FAIL; vision with a 1,048,576-pixel cap: 305,194; vision with encoder profiling skipped: 305,194 (unprofiled); vision + MTP-2 + fp8 KV: 464,709 (PASS, +45%)
receipts.caveat: Staging card, warm compile cache, one boot each. The encoder-cache profiling takes about 26K tokens of KV. The pixel-capped variant would have limited images to about 1 megapixel, which is why the combined profile was chosen.
